STEP 2 - Vessel: The plate is a large square one, roughly 28 cm across. I treat it as a 28 cm square, so its area is about 784 cm² (28 × 28). The formula for a round plate would give about 615 cm², but the plate is square.

STEP 3 - Items: There is one food item, a piece of cheese pizza with crust, tomato sauce and melted cheese.

STEP 4 - Area: The pizza is about 11 × 7 cm, which is roughly 75 cm². That covers about 10% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: 75 cm² × 1.5 cm thick = 112 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: 112 ml × 0.6 g/ml = about 67 g. I used 0.6 rather than the bread-slice range because pizza dough is somewhat airy, between a bread loaf and a dense slice. I round this to 70 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cheese pizza is about 270 kcal per 100 g. 70 g × 2.7 = about 189 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small square slice of pizza at around 70 g and 190 kcal is plausible.
